pr_title: [download_dsyms] Added 'live' version parameter to only download live_version dSYMs
pr_body:
### Checklist
- [x] I've run `bundle exec rspec` from the root directory to see all new and existing tests pass
- [x] I've followed the _fastlane_ code style and run `bundle exec rubocop -a` to ensure the code style is valid
- [x] I've read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I've updated the documentation if necessary.

### Motivation and Context
This should fix https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/15308

### Description
Added a new `if version == 'live'` next to `if version == 'latest'` check to only fetch the dSYMs of latest live version.

### Testing Steps
Added a new test in `fastlane/spec/actions_specs/download_dsyms_spec.rb`

issue_context.title: `download_dsyms` action is missing a fetching 'live' version option
issue_context.body:
### Feature Request

#### Motivation Behind Feature
We have setup a Jenkins job that executes every 3 days to download the dSYMs from App Store Connect and uploads it to New Relic.

While doing that, we noticed that `download_dsyms` only has the option of `version: 'lastest'` or passing specific build version.

But since we are disabling BITCODE_ENABLED for our tests builds (faster waiting for processing time), we would only need to upload dSYM files for our latest released App Store live version.

As our apps are always in heavy development, 'lastest' option doesn't return our desired version.

Example app versions in App Store Connect:

* **3.9.1** (live_version, released App Store version)
* **4.0** (edit_version, waiting for review)
* **4.1** (test build uploaded to TestFlight only)

`'latest'` would return a build from the **4.1** train.

#### Feature Description

Add another `version: 'live'` option to the action to only fetch the latest released App Store live version.

I'm currently preparing a PR for this (my first one ^^)
comments: I've now opened a PR to add this. Any feedback is much appreciated. This is my first PR 😅

The pull request #15309 that closed this issue was merged and released as part of [_fastlane_ 2.134.0](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/releases/tag/2.134.0) :rocket:
Please let us know if the functionality works as expected as a reply here. If it does not, please open a new issue. Thanks!

review_comments: full disclosure: I was not sure how to adapt the tests with a live_version. I hope this is correct 😅
